freeze_gates: E records full-suite tests passed and confirms members are frozen.
Every package member SHA-256 equals the frozen candidate manifest; no missing or extra files.
steps: Build the ZIP from the frozen whitelist only; calculate ZIP byte size and SHA-256.
Extract into a new isolated verification directory; scan for .env secrets, tokens, personal data, runtime databases, and unlisted files.
In the extracted directory, select and record free loopback API/Web ports; start with a unique Compose project and --build.
Verify Docker Compose service status, API /health, channel status, and browser HTTP access to the Web home page.
Run the fixed authorized historical case under offline_dynamic_substitute; verify task progress and terminal state.
Open the report and alert in the browser; verify the five modules, identical case/graph/run binding, provisional warning, and WeCom/email dry_run with zero network requests and sent_at=null.
Stop then start all package containers normally; verify health and Web again, and compare case/task/report/alert record hashes.
Write only under artifacts/final-closure/delivery-verification/ and artifacts/final-closure/d-delivery-ready.json; do not modify frozen members.
failure_route: If frozen package contents omit a required file or cannot pass the extracted-copy check, do not patch the ZIP. Write status=needs_revision and concrete evidence into d-delivery-ready.json for E/main integration to handle.
